action.objective: Verify g6a6 (rook to a6, winning the a6 pawn and hitting d5/f5 structure) as the reserved candidate at full depth.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search gave g6a6 an exact 844 with PV g6a6 b2c2 f7d5 c2c3, winning a6 and centralizing the bishop; Black's b2 rook will grab c2. Reserve protects this move, so I spend the 2000-node single-candidate verification to confirm no tactical refutation (Black mate-in-1 checks / checking chain) before committing.
